name: ByteArrayView
documentation:
Read-only view of a byte-array range for serializers that can consume a slice directly.

The backing array must not be modified. Calling {@link #get()} retains the ordinary {@code byte[]} contract and may materialize an independent array.

methods.name: array
methods.documentation: Returns the backing byte array without copying it.

methods.name: length
methods.documentation: Returns the number of bytes covered by this view.

methods.name: offset
methods.documentation: Returns the zero-based offset where this view starts in the backing array.
